name: fraudlens-root
description: Root scripts to run the whole FraudLens stack from one terminal

scripts.start: concurrently -n FLASK,NODE,FRONTEND -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend/ml_service && python app.py" "cd backend/node && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n FLASK,NODE,FRONTEND,REPLAY -c blue,green,yellow,magenta --kill-others "cd backend/ml_service && python app.py" "cd backend/node && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start" "npx wait-on http://localhost:5000/api/settings && cd ml && python replay.py --demo --force-rings --speed 0.3"
